polls.description: Chinese AI startup DeepSeek's massive $7B funding round signals intensifying global AI competition and China's challenge to US tech dominance.
polls.question: Is DeepSeek's rise a threat to US AI dominance or healthy competition?

cluster_stories.title: DeepSeek lines up its first outside money: a $7bn round at up to $59bn
cluster_stories.summary: DeepSeek has spent eighteen months as the most talked-about AI lab that almost nobody could invest in. That is about to change. The Chinese startup is slated to raise roughly 50 billion yuan, about $7bn, in its first external funding round, according to people familiar with the matter, in a deal that would value it […] This story continues at The Next Web
cluster_stories.headline: DEEPSEEK RAISES $7B AT $59B VALUATION... FIRST OUTSIDE FUNDING

cluster_stories.title: DeepSeek Close to Sealing $7 Billion Funding in Historic AI Deal
cluster_stories.summary: DeepSeek is close to finalizing a deal to raise about 50 billion yuan ($7.4 billion) from investors including Tencent Holdings Ltd. and its own founder in one of China’s largest startup financings, a milestone for a domestic AI industry seeking capital to take on marquee US names like OpenAI.

cluster_stories.summary: Two days. That is how long Nvidia’s latest robotics model sat at the top of the RoboArena leaderboard before a startup from Hangzhou knocked it off. On Wednesday, Spirit AI announced that its foundation model for embodied intelligence, Spirit v1.6, had scored 1,924 on the benchmark, edging out Nvidia’s Cosmos3-Nano-Policy at 1,881. cluster_stories.headline: CHINESE STARTUP DETHRONGS NVIDIA ON ITS OWN BENCHMARK

cluster_stories.title: Someone did an audit on the new DeepSWE, the results aren't pretty
cluster_stories.summary: While this post on the DeepSWE Benchmark github is mainly focused on DeepSeek failing in many places where it shouldn't, it shows many problems with how the benchmark was conducted. It seems that the benchmark was rushed out the door and still needs a lot more work before it can be considered a reliable reference for the quality of the models they benchmarked.   submitted by   /u/pneuny [link]   [comments]
cluster_stories.headline: DEEPSEEK AUDIT REVEALS Serious Benchmark Flaws

polls.description: Massive infrastructure investments are flowing into AI data centers and computing power, particularly in India and Asia-Pacific regions.

cluster_stories.summary: AirTrunk, a data center operator backed by Blackstone Inc., plans to invest about $30 billion in India over the next few years to tap the country’s rapidly expanding AI and cloud markets.

cluster_stories.title: Google Buying Computing From SpaceX in $920-Million-a-Month Deal
